title: The Fifth Floor
hook: The old hotel's elevator had one rule: if it stops on the fifth floor after midnight, don't step out... and don't let anyone step in.
lines: The old hotel in the mountains had one elevator... and one card taped inside it.
After midnight, if this elevator stops on the fifth floor, don't step out. And don't let anyone step in.
I laughed. There were only four buttons.
My first night, I went down for ice around one a.m. The whole hotel was asleep.
On the way back up, the elevator passed four... and kept climbing.
The doors opened on a hallway I'd never seen. Green wallpaper. One bare bulb, swinging slowly.
A bellhop stood there in an old red uniform, holding a suitcase. My suitcase.
Your room is ready, he said. Just step out.
I didn't move. I pressed the close button... again, and again, and again.
He never stepped forward. He just smiled... as the doors slid shut.
The elevator sank back down to four. I let out a breath. I was alone.
The doors opened on my floor... and from the corner right behind me, a polite voice said...
